description: Multiply out a retry policy and report what its own numbers imply. Computes the worst-case duration and the amplification factor, then reports a budget that outlives the caller's timeout so later attempts run with nobody waiting; backoff with no jitter, where clients that failed together retry together; unbounded growth; retrying a 4xx that cannot become a success; retrying 429 while ignoring Retry-After; and retrying POST or PATCH with no idempotency key. Pay 180000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

caller_timeout_ms.description: How long the caller waits before giving up. Supplying it is what lets the worst case be compared against something.

idempotency_key_sent.description: Whether the caller sends an idempotency key, which is what makes retrying a non-idempotent method safe. Defaults to false.

policy.description: The retry policy: max_attempts, base_delay_ms, multiplier, max_delay_ms, per_attempt_timeout_ms, jitter, and retry_on with status_codes, methods and honour_retry_after. Nothing is fetched and nothing is executed, so an arbitrary configuration can be audited without access to the system it governs.

name: retry_policy_audit

complete.description: Whether everything supplied was examined. False means part of it was not, which is a different problem from something that is wrong.

finding_count.description: The true total, even when the listing is bounded.

passed.description: The same verdict under the name shared across the caller-supplied families.

request_id.description: Delivery request identifier; also returned in x-foundry-request-id.

sound.description: True only when nothing was found and every declared value could be read.

title: Retry Policy Audit
